about.aboutUsParagraph1: Sport never stops, and neither do we. GO CHAMPS was born to transform championship management with simplicity and reliable data. Forget confusing spreadsheets and lost statistics.
about.aboutUsParagraph2: We want you to feel the atmosphere of competition in every detail. That is why we deliver — from amateur to semi-professional — fast information, clean visuals, and an experience designed for everyone: those who organize with mastery, those who play with grit, and those who cheer with their heart.
about.aboutUsParagraph3: GO CHAMPS is the home of sport. Our platform was designed to be as fast as a counter-attack and as clear as a blowout victory.
about.aboutUsListItem1: Electronic match reports and updated calendars.
about.aboutUsListItem2: Brackets and results in real time.
about.aboutUsParagraph4: Whether you are the organizer seeking efficiency, the athlete wanting visibility, or the passionate fan, GO CHAMPS is your place.
about.lairBio: Passionate about building in community — whether in tech teams or on the basketball courts.
about.lairCta: Want to get to know me better?
about.isaBio: Transforming problems into experiences. Obsessed with understanding people. Between data, intuition, and design, I am also an Astrologer.
about.ruanBio: I enjoy working in environments where hard problems are the norm and engineering quality is taken seriously.
about.wagnerBio: Nerd, fan of sports like basketball and soccer, supporter of SC Internacional.
about.juliaBio: I connect people and purposes through communication. Intense, passionate about people, about pets, and about life — a dreamer in essence and practical in action.

faq.faqQ1Answer: GO CHAMPS is a platform to follow tournaments, games, and stats from amateur to semi-professional level — all in one place.
faq.faqQ2Question: Do I need an account to use it?
faq.faqQ2Answer: You can browse without an account, but creating one unlocks extra features like pinning tournaments and receiving updates.
faq.faqQ3Question: How do I find my tournament?
faq.faqQ3Answer: Use the search bar at the top of the page to find your tournament by name or organization.
faq.faqQ4Question: Are results updated in real time?
faq.faqQ4Answer: Results are updated as data is submitted by tournament organizers, keeping everything as current as possible.
faq.faqQ5Question: I forgot my password. What now?
faq.faqQ5Answer: Go to the Account Recovery page and enter your email. We'll send you a link to reset your password.
